title: SEND_KEYS_SETTLE_MS = 50 is still an unexplained magnitude (carried forward fro…
body: SEND_KEYS_SETTLE_MS = 50 is still an unexplained magnitude (carried forward from round 1). The JSDoc justifies why a settle window exists but not why 50 ms is the right size for one tmux refresh cycle. A one-line note on how the value was chosen (measured, or a deliberate conservative floor) would make a future tuning change safe.

title: The default-deadline test monkeypatches the global Date.now and process.stderr.…
body: The default-deadline test monkeypatches the global Date.now and process.stderr.write. Both are correctly restored in a finally block and bun runs a file's tests serially, so this is safe today, but a shared withFakeClock helper under test/helpers/ would make the pattern reusable and harder to leak if the test is ever copied.
